topic: Mohe 1997 eclipse gravity anomaly — v3 goalpost-move rewrite (EXP-604) deep-attack verification
our_argument_summary: WIN-011 (verdict: Not Demonstrated) argues the dome silently rewrote its flagship gravity claim on 2026-04-17 (commit 6e06efb) from -6.5 uGal at eclipse maximum (V51.0, our 2026-04-05 capture) to ~7.0 +/- 2.7 uGal at first/last contact (C1/C4) where Wang et al. 2000 had already located the signal; that the timing rule is a 2026 retrofit to 2000 data (post-hoc); that the dome credits the rewrite as more honest while showing it self-refutes (CONFIRMED label + open thermal-tilt loophole + deferral to an unrun 2026-08-12 SG test = pending, not confirmed); and that the kappa=1.67 coupling now fails the dome’s own 5% tolerance on its own new value (10.9/7.0=1.557, 7.25% error) because monitor.py and live WIN-012 still consume the superseded 6.5.

Value adoption plus verbal retrofit.

holes_found.description: detail_evidence characterizes the dome as having ‘cites a globe counter-paper against itself (Unnikrishnan et al. 2001)’, but the LIVE dome page (wins.html line 235) deploys Unnikrishnan OFFENSIVELY as ‘Globe Counter 1’ that it defeats: ‘Rules out gravitational shielding hypothesis ... Shielding is ruled out’, then (line 239) ‘Globe shielding mechanism ruled out by Unnikrishnan 2001. ECM contact-phase prediction is the best current fit.’ The dome cites the paper against a RIVAL globe hypothesis (shielding), not against itself. The only support our text quotes is the paper’s title, which is shielding-specific and does NOT establish that the paper cuts against the dome’s own anomaly claim. A defender (the author reads this review) can screenshot line 235 and say we fabricated a concession. The point IS salvageable — Unnikrishnan et al. 2001’s actual conclusion is that the 1997 data are consistent with conventional/instrumental explanations, which undercuts the dome’s anomaly itself — but as written the claim is unsupported and screenshot-refutable.
holes_found.recommendation: Reframe: ‘the dome quotes Unnikrishnan only to dismiss a rival globe hypothesis (shielding), while ignoring that the same paper concludes the 1997 data are consistent with conventional/instrumental explanations — i.e. it undercuts the dome’s anomaly claim, not just shielding.’ Quote Unnikrishnan’s conclusion, not just the title. OR drop the ‘against itself’ item from the concessions list — the bundling argument survives on the magnitude/phase correction, the ‘Mechanism Contested’ label, the thermal-tilt concession, and the deferral to the 2026 test.

holes_found.description: The ‘silently rewrote / moved the goalposts / here are the receipts’ framing is dense (‘silently’ recurs ~5x across finding/detail_evidence/detail_verdict_text/detail_extra/tldr). A public git commit is not literally ‘silent’; the substantive basis is the commit MESSAGE (‘Add methodology-first audit layer and claim taxonomy’) not flagging that the flagship gravity claim changed magnitude, phase and status — which is true and verified, but the bare repeated ‘silently’ invites the author (confirmed reader) to counter that we are calling a public commit ‘secret’ and punishing legitimate data-driven refinement. Note the review already and correctly credits the rewrite as ‘more honest — credit where due’, which blunts the over-rhetoric somewhat.
holes_found.recommendation: Define ‘silently’ once and precisely (= the substantive claim change was not noted in the commit message labeled ‘Add methodology-first audit layer and claim taxonomy’), then reduce repetition. Keep the substantive post-hoc/retrodiction point, which does not depend on the pejorative.

holes_found.description: The new ‘two different phases’ sub-argument (‘the -10.9 nT numerator is an eclipse-maximum value (BOU 2017), while the dome now insists the gravity effect peaks at the contacts — the κ constant divides values at two different phases of two different eclipses on two different continents’) rests on an unsourced in-text phase attribution: neither WIN-012 nor the dome’s wins.html explicitly states the -10.9 nT BOU 2017 value is an eclipse-MAXIMUM value. It is defensible from the dome’s own magnetic model (the eclipse ΔB formula ΔB = -18.22 x coverage x FSF scales with coverage, so ΔB peaks at maximum coverage), but as written a defender could contest the maximum-vs-contact attribution and collapse the sub-argument.
holes_found.recommendation: Add a one-clause justification (e.g. ‘a maximum-coverage quantity by the dome’s own ΔB = -18.22 x coverage x FSF formula’) or cite where the -10.9 nT sits in the 2017 eclipse timeline; alternatively soften to ‘a coverage-peak value’.

stronger_arguments.description: Quote Unnikrishnan et al. 2001’s operative conclusion (the 1997 Allais-type eclipse gravity data are explainable by conventional/instrumental effects and do not require new physics) to convert the ‘against itself’ assertion into a demonstrated point: the dome’s own cited authority denies the existence of a genuine anomalous gravitational effect, which is precisely what WIN-011 is.

stronger_arguments.description: Make the κ phase-mismatch explicit and self-contained by deriving the maximum-phase status of ΔB from the dome’s own coverage-scaling formula on the same page, so the ‘divides values at two different phases’ point is grounded in dome text rather than asserted.

kernel_of_truth.description: Two genuine kernels, both reconfirmed against current sources this run. (1) The contact-phase gravity valleys are real, peer-reviewed geophysics (data/wins.json id=011 detail_evidence; Wang et al. 2000, PRD 62, 041101; Yang & Wang 2002, 10.1023/A:1021119023985). (2) The dome’s rewritten WIN-011 is materially more honest than the version it replaced — it now reports the correct magnitude with uncertainty and the correct C1/C4 phases, labels the claim ‘CONFIRMED (Mechanism Contested)’, concedes ‘Thermal tilt cannot be ruled out ... This is the open loophole’, and names a dated falsifiable test (live wins.html lines 233–240, fetched 2026-06-09).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Being more honest is not the same as being confirmed. By the dome’s own scoring the claim is pending an unrun 2026-08-12 SG test (live wins.html line 240; tracked as data/predictions.json PRED-TIER-3, our_verdict=pending), and the κ coupling that would make the eclipse signal dome-specific fails the dome’s own 5% tolerance on the dome’s own new value (10.9/7.0=1.557, 7.25% > 5%) while monitor.py Domain 7 and live WIN-012 (wins.html line 247) still consume the superseded 6.5. The verdict ‘Not Demonstrated’ (data/wins.json id=011) is the correct disposition: real signal, contested mechanism, undemonstrated dome-specific coupling.

deeper_analysis: The EXP-604 rewrite fully resolves the c9 critical hole (stale claim attribution): the new text correctly frames -6.5/maximum as the V51.0 capture and 7.0/contacts as the live page, and I independently re-verified the live page TODAY (wins.html fetched 2026-06-09, 91,723 bytes; line 231 ‘CONFIRMED (Mechanism Contested)’, line 234 C1/C4 timing rule, line 238 ‘open loophole’, line 240 ‘August 12, 2026 SG Level-3’) — the goalpost-move framing is grounded in current dome content, not a stale capture. The c9 major holes 1 and 2 are also resolved: the ‘the dome states no rule’ / intermittency sentence is gone (grep: absent), and the concessions are now credited. The arithmetic is exact against live monitor.py. The remaining exposure is presentational/argumentative, not factual: (a) the Unnikrishnan ‘against itself’ characterization mis-describes the dome’s offensive use of the paper and is screenshot-refutable [major]; (b) the ‘silently’ framing is over-dense for an author-read document [moderate]; (c) the -10.9 nT maximum-phase attribution is unsourced in-text though defensible [minor]. None require a verdict change — ‘Not Demonstrated’ holds, with the κ self-contradiction correctly housed in WIN-012 (verdict Self-Contradicted) and the SG-null refutations in WIN-013/014 (Refuted by Data). Advocate-mode: the dome’s strongest reply is that WIN-011 is now an honest, dated, falsifiable, mechanism-contested prediction — which the review concedes — so ‘pending’ (≈ our Not Demonstrated) is the fair call and the ‘goalpost’ rhetoric punishes legitimate refinement; the review already absorbs most of this by crediting the honesty, which is why the fixes above are edits, not a rewrite.
